h:
这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的指导 Pix2Pix HiDream Editor GGUF 工作流程，可与单个 HiDream Editor GGUF 模型一起使用。通过此功能，您可以使用非常具体的目标提示来编辑图像的非常有针对性的部分（例如衣服的颜色、发型、背景等）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 HiDream Editor GGUF 模型和其他模型，然后加载

#2.您要使用非常具体的目标指令 Pix2Pix 提示编辑的图像

＃3。然后输入您的提示。保持简短且非常有针对性，与常规 HiDream 模型不同，非特定的通用提示不会产生良好的结果。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置。 CFG 太低或太高都不会产生良好的结果。

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

享受吧！

### 要使用此工作流程，您需要登录 Huggingface 并从那里下载必要的文件（我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中包含了一个文本文件，您可以在其中找到更多关于我的其他工作流程的基本下载的链接）-

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly instruct Pix2Pix HiDream Editor GGUF workflow that will work with a single HiDream Editor GGUF model. With this you can edit a very targeted portion of your image (say for example color of dress, hairstyle, background etc.) with a very specific targeted prompt. Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1 and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired HiDream Editor GGUF model and other models first and then load

#2. the image you want to edit using a very specific targeted instruct Pix2Pix prompt

#3. then input your prompt. Keep it brief and very specifically targeted, unlike regular HiDream model non-specific generic prompt will not produce good result.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings. Too low or too high CFG will not produce good result.

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

Enjoy!

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -
